summary: Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega is a 2000 Hindi romance film directed by Raj Kanwar, starring Salman Khan, Rani Mukerji and Preity Zinta, with a special appearance by Shah Rukh Khan. The note says critics praised it and that it was the third hit in a row for the Salman Khan and Sajid Nadiadwala collaboration, becoming the year's fourth highest grosser. The film is a remake of the 1997 Malayalam film Chandralekha starring Mohanlal, with minor elements loosely based on the film While You Were Sleeping.
one_line: A 2000 Hindi romance film directed by Raj Kanwar, starring Salman Khan and Rani Mukerji, remade from the 1997 Malayalam film Chandralekha.
key_facts: Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega is a 2000 Indian Hindi romance film directed by Raj Kanwar.
The English meaning of the title Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega is "Every Heart That Loves".
The film stars Salman Khan, Rani Mukerji and Preity Zinta.
Shah Rukh Khan makes a special appearance in Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega.
The film was highly praised by the critics.
Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega was the third hit in a row for the Salman Khan-Sajid Nadiadwala collaboration.
Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega became the fourth highest grosser of the year 2000.
Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega is a remake of the 1997 Malayalam film Chandralekha.
The plot of Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega has minor elements loosely based on the film While You Were Sleeping.
